dedupe_keys.name: 500 m annual irrigated cropland maps of china 2000 2019 synergy mapping

description: This dataset gives annual 500 m maps of irrigated cropland across China from 2000 to 2019, described in a Scientific Data descriptor. The authors first fused a MODIS greenness index with irrigation statistics into intermediate maps (MIrAD-GI), then merged those with all existing irrigation maps of China using constrained statistics and a synergy mapping method. The authors suggest water departments can use it to evaluate irrigation infrastructure. Coverage is China, yearly for two decades. The maps are a free download from figshare under CC BY 4.0 as binary GeoTIFF files in WGS84, with the Python code. Caveats: overall accuracy against 5,648 ground points was moderate, 0.732 to 0.819, and 500 m cells blur small irrigated fields. Simulation uses: irrigated extent and its change for irrigation demand and capacity planning. Related records: IrriMap_CN, a separate 500 m product for the same period (data-irrimap-cn-annual-irrigation-maps-china), and the FAO global map of irrigation areas (data-fao-global-map-of-irrigation-areas).
